# authwise_appearance_profile (Resource)

An issuer's appearance profile: a theme plus overrides of its `stylesheet_attributes` and `content`, key by key. The issuer's default profile (`is_default`) is the issuer's appearance; a client's or audience's `appearance_profile_id` overrides it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The issuer's appearance: its default profile. A profile's
# stylesheet_attributes and content override its theme's, key by key.
resource "authwise_appearance_profile" "default" {
  display_name = "Example"
  theme_id     = authwise_theme.brand.theme_id
  is_default   = true

  content = jsonencode({
    subheading = "Sign in to Example"
  })
}

# A second profile on the same theme, for one client.
resource "authwise_appearance_profile" "partners" {
  display_name = "Example for partners"
  theme_id     = authwise_theme.brand.theme_id

  stylesheet_attributes = jsonencode({
    primary_main = "5B4B8A"
    link_color   = "5B4B8A"
  })

  content = jsonencode({
    heading    = "Partner portal"
    subheading = "Sign in with your partner account"
  })
}

resource "authwise_client" "portal" {
  display_name          = "Partner portal"
  audience_id           = authwise_audience.portal.audience_id
  grant_types           = ["authorization_code", "refresh_token"]
  config                = data.authwise_interactive_client_config.portal.any
  appearance_profile_id = authwise_appearance_profile.partners.appearance_profile_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `content` (String) `content` as a JSON object.
- `display_name` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this profile is its issuer's default, and so the issuer's appearance. Set it to `true` on the one profile that should be the default, and leave it out on the others. The issuer's first profile becomes the default whatever this says. To move the default, set it on the new profile and remove it from the old one.
- `issuer_id` (String) Parent identifier `issuer_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `stylesheet_attributes` (String) `stylesheet_attributes` as a JSON object.
- `tenant_id` (String) Parent identifier `tenant_id`; overrides the provider default, and reads back from the name. Changing a configured one replaces the resource.
- `theme_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `appearance_profile_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `name` (String) Full resource name; serves as the Terraform ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by full resource name.
terraform import authwise_appearance_profile.example tenants/t-01/issuers/i-01/appearance-profiles/ap-01
```
